work_packages.title: Establish authoritative baseline and repair ledger
work_packages.objective: Create one reproducible source identity, feature baseline, environment report, and restartable evidence ledger before product edits.
deliverables: clean worktree or exact extracted-source baseline
work_packages.fail_forward: If Git history is unavailable, use the supplied archive hash and generated source manifest as authority. Do not invent commit lineage.

work_packages.title: Make completion truth manager-owned and gate-specific
work_packages.objective: Eliminate generic evidence-hash gate bypass and require registered deterministic validators for every completion gate.
deliverables: completion request tool that cannot nominate proof hashes
work_packages.fail_forward: Keep runs in validatingCompletion or blocked with a machine-readable reason; never fall back to the current hash-presence validator.

work_packages.title: Unify continuity authority and remove managed-mode manual rollover
work_packages.objective: Make project-scoped canonical continuity the only authority in managed autonomous mode while retaining an explicitly labeled external-host compatibility mode.
deliverables: managed-mode bypass/removal of legacy fixed-count blocker
no global latest fallback for bootstrap authority
required_tests: managed loop never emits manual-new-chat instruction
work_packages.fail_forward: If an external host cannot create sessions, report externalMCPCompatibility truthfully; do not block or misrepresent managed mode.

work_packages.title: Implement immutable instruction-package ingestion and catalog
work_packages.objective: Accept directories, ZIP, .forgepackage, and compatible .forge-codex inputs through secure immutable ingestion without executing from source locations.
required_tests: mutation during ingestion rejected or quarantined
source deletion after ingestion does not affect stored package
crash recovery at every ingestion state
work_packages.fail_forward: Quarantine uncertain candidates with a durable reason. Never execute partially validated content.

work_packages.title: Build durable Work Queue, leases, scheduler, package tools, and UI
work_packages.objective: Create a manager-owned durable queue that automatically reserves, runs, checkpoints, validates, completes, and advances packages without operator intervention.
deliverables: Work Queue tab and view model
work_packages.fail_forward: A lease ambiguity must resolve to at most one accepted active run. Preserve the package in a recoverable nonterminal state.

work_packages.title: Implement safe selective project reset
work_packages.objective: Add memory, continuity, combined, and run-history reset operations with maintenance barriers, backup, generation fencing, receipts, and native UI.
required_tests: history cleanup preserves current project identity
work_packages.fail_forward: If backup or fencing cannot be proven, abort before mutation and return a durable nonretrying receipt.

work_packages.title: Complete operator controls and authoritative projections
work_packages.objective: Replace disabled placeholders with authenticated typed manager commands and accurate provider/runtime/project/continuity projections.
required_tests: each control invokes the intended manager route
work_packages.fail_forward: Controls remain enabled only when the manager publishes capability and authorization; unsupported actions show a precise reason, not an empty button.

work_packages.title: Implement and qualify hardened XPC runtime isolation
work_packages.objective: Add a separately signed App Sandbox XPC helper for hardened runtime profiles while keeping existing shell and workspace-isolated execution intact.
work_packages.fail_forward: If a runtime cannot operate under the declared sandbox, report it unsupported for hardenedXPC and retain workspaceIsolated with truthful labeling.

work_packages.title: Wire resource pressure, retention, telemetry, and gauge efficiency
work_packages.objective: Make physical-memory and pressure policy operational across scheduler, runtime, provider, telemetry, event retention, and Metal rendering.
work_packages.fail_forward: Reduce concurrency and visual cadence before dropping correctness data. Active run/continuity evidence cannot be pruned.

work_packages.title: Harden loopback dashboard transport and authorization
work_packages.objective: Bound accepted connections and require authorization for sensitive reads while retaining a minimal unauthenticated health surface.
required_tests: health endpoint leaks no project data
work_packages.fail_forward: Fail closed for sensitive routes and shed excess connections predictably; never increase unbounded queues.

work_packages.title: Close E2 filesystem race through atomic namespace capture
work_packages.objective: Integrate and complete the supplied E2 secure-filesystem design so verification and destructive mutation are not separate pathname operations.
work_packages.fail_forward: Do not mark E2 closed for quarantine-and-verify alone. If a platform/volume lacks required atomicity, reject that operation with a precise unsupported result.

work_packages.title: Restore source/test parity, package cleanliness, documentation, and modularity
work_packages.objective: Make repository instructions self-contained, align SwiftPM and Xcode tests, remove transient/local artifacts, update documentation, and reduce risk in touched large files.
deliverables: installed continuity/E2 design references or superseding docs
no absolute local paths in shipping docs/state
work_packages.fail_forward: Do not rewrite stable large files merely for style. Split only along tested ownership boundaries and preserve public contracts.

work_packages.title: Run signed native, shell, provider, continuity, and crash qualification
work_packages.objective: Prove the real macOS product path rather than relying on compile-only or synthetic evidence.
deliverables: real LM Studio threshold rollover transcript
work_packages.fail_forward: Use an ephemeral local code-signing identity when distribution credentials are unavailable. Do not substitute build-for-testing for executed tests.

work_packages.title: Integrated low-memory and endurance qualification
work_packages.objective: Demonstrate two-package autonomous execution, rollover, restart, queue advancement, bounded memory, and quiescent rendering under constrained profiles.
required_tests: queue package A then B across restart and rollover
no monotonic unbounded RSS after warmup
no lost or duplicate tool effects
work_packages.fail_forward: If a budget fails, preserve the failing trace and return to the owning phase. Do not relax the budget without a recorded design decision and replacement user-visible contract.

work_packages.title: Produce a shippable release candidate and stop before shipping
work_packages.objective: Create a locally validated release candidate, source/evidence attestation, and readiness report while performing no publication or distribution action.
deliverables: known-issues report with no Critical/High entries
work_packages.fail_forward: Stop with ready_to_ship=false if any mandatory gate is incomplete. Never tag, merge, publish, upload, submit, or distribute.
